description: Michael's survival, Sydney's legal troubles and Kimberly's instability collide with Alison's alcoholism, Jo's fight for her child and Amanda's illness. By spring, Brooke is engineering Billy's future, Jess is destabilizing Jake and Jo, and Kimberly is preparing a spectacularly destructive answer to everyone she blames.

s03e01.description: Michael survives the hit-and-run with amnesia, while Jane's evidence shifts suspicion toward Sydney and Kimberly offers Sydney an alibi.

s03e02.description: Kimberly brings Michael home, while imprisoned Sydney recruits Matt to investigate Kimberly and clashes with her father over a plea deal.

s03e03.description: Chris pressures Jane through a business deal, while Sydney reaches out from the hospital and begs Matt to uncover Kimberly's role in her downfall.

s03e04.description: Sydney uses a false identity to get close to Michael, whose memory abruptly returns after another near accident.

s03e05.description: The Pretty Lady explodes and Jake is feared dead until the Coast Guard finds him alive, stunning Jo, Amanda and the rest of Melrose.

s03e06.description: Jo and Amanda blame each other for Jake's departure, while Jake meets his biological father and is persuaded to return home.

s03e07.description: Jake buys Shooters with his reward money, while Chris insults Sydney in front of Jake and exposes his predatory attitude.

s03e08.description: Jake shelters Sydney after an attack, and Sydney races to stop Chris when she realizes he intends to marry Jane in Las Vegas.

s03e09.description: Jake convinces Sydney not to run from her problems, while Alison pretends to accept Billy and Susan and quietly turns to alcohol.

s03e10.description: Jo's custody trial puts the entire Melrose circle under scrutiny as lawyers attack her friends' credibility and her fitness as a mother.

s03e11.description: Zack feeds Alison's reckless drinking and spending, prompting Billy and Susan to confront her during a disastrous Thanksgiving.

s03e12.description: Alison is arrested for drunk driving and seeks comfort from Billy, who refuses to abandon his relationship with Susan.

s03e13.description: A medical consortium takes control of D and D, Peter elevates Amanda, and Alison's worsening drinking produces frightening blackouts.

s03e14.description: Alison clashes with Terry in recovery and relapses after Billy misses an important support meeting.

s03e15.description: Amanda's hard-edged behavior is challenged by a surreal Christmas dream that forces her to examine the damage she causes.

s03e16.description: Peter hires efficiency expert Caitlin to shake up D and D, while Alison's romance with Terry pulls her farther away from Billy.

s03e17-18.description: Jo realizes her baby's kidnapping was orchestrated and learns Kimberly helped the Carters discover that the child survived. Jake and Jo locate the Carters with the baby, but Jo refuses to wait safely for police before confronting them.

s03e19.description: Vandalism turns Jo, Jane and Jake against Sydney, leaving her isolated enough to fall deeper under Martin's cult influence.

s03e20.description: Amanda resists Michael's involvement in her cancer treatment before accepting his support and sharing the diagnosis with Billy.

s03e21.description: Jane and Jake try to rescue Sydney from Martin's cult, only to find Sydney frighteningly loyal to the man manipulating her.

s03e22.description: Michael takes Amanda to New York for experimental cancer treatment, while Kimberly secretly sabotages Amanda's chance of being accepted.

s03e23.description: Alison enters Amanda's campaign in an advertising competition and is persuaded by ambitious Brooke Armstrong to submit her own work.

s03e24.description: Alison replaces Amanda as D and D president and briefly reconnects with Billy, while Brooke begins embedding herself inside the agency.

s03e25.description: Amanda recovers at Michael's house and recruits Brooke to undermine Alison, turning personal resentment into an office campaign.

s03e26.description: Michael is forced to seek help for Kimberly after Sydney appears, and Sydney quietly steals Kimberly's suicide note.

s03e27.description: Kimberly attends a survival retreat where stress and hallucinations blur her fears of Jo, Amanda, Jane and Sydney.

s03e28.description: Amanda and Brooke finally force Alison out of D and D, while Jake confronts Jo over her growing involvement with Jess.

s03e29.description: Jake's feud with Jess escalates into a staged robbery and shooting, while Brooke arranges a tempting Hong Kong escape for Alison.

s03e30.description: Jake suspects Jess arranged his shooting, while Brooke intercepts Alison's message and engineers a false breakup with Billy.

s03e31-32.description: Peter helps Michael out of jail and seeks his support before the medical board as Kimberly's increasingly dangerous plans close in. Alison returns from Hong Kong too late to stop Billy marrying Brooke, while Jo recoils from Jess's pressure for marriage and Melrose faces catastrophe.
